faqs.question: How do I download a game?
faqs.answer: Go to the Library, pick the game you want and press Download. Once the installation finishes, it will appear in My Games ready to play.

faqs.question: Why do I need Kirin?
faqs.answer: The games are made for Windows, and Android cannot run them on its own. Kirin is the app that runs them on Android: the launcher downloads, installs and updates the games and adds them to Kirin's library, and Kirin runs them when you press Play. Kirin 0.4.0 or later is required, as it is the first version that lets other apps add games to its library and open them. Thanks to Max for helping with the integration and for creating Kirin, the emulator that lets us play these games on Android. More information at https://playkirin.com/

faqs.question: Where are games installed and how do I change the folder?
faqs.answer: On Android, games are installed in the LostieLauncher folder of the internal storage, and that folder cannot be changed. If you uninstall the launcher, the installed games are not removed: you can delete them manually from that folder.

faqs.question: Will I lose my saved games when updating or uninstalling a game?
faqs.answer: No. Saved games are always kept, both when updating and when uninstalling a game.

faqs.question: What is a special version and how do I activate it?
faqs.answer: It is an alternative version of a game unlocked with a key in the format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. You can enter the key when downloading the game or switch to the special version from My Games without losing anything.

faqs.question: What does offline mode mean?
faqs.answer: It means the launcher can't reach the server, either because you have no internet connection or because the server is under maintenance. You can keep playing your installed games; downloads, updates and special versions will reactivate automatically when the connection returns.

faqs.question: I found a bug, where do I report it?
faqs.answer: Open an issue in the launcher's GitHub repository explaining what happened and what you were doing. The more detail you give, the easier it will be to fix.
